findings.explanation: Dupre orders them to do it once more, continuing the same passage identified on line 1. Todokanai TL changes that into starting from the top of the entire work, a materially different rehearsal instruction.

findings.evidenceJa: なんだその腑抜けたピアノは
findings.explanation: Dupre attacks Kazusa's piano as spineless or lifeless. Todokanai TL makes Kazusa herself completely useless, changing a severe musical criticism into a broader judgment of the person.
findings.japanese:
「なんだその腑抜けたピアノは…
若手ナンバーワンの成長株だという触れ込みだったが、
とんだ期待はずれだ」
findings.todokanai: "You're completely useless… I heard you were the peerless up and coming pianist, young and full of promise, but this is so far from what I expected."

findings.highlight: my long awaited meeting with the orchestra
findings.explanation: Kazusa has finally reached the first joint ensemble rehearsal, not an introductory meeting. The next lines describe exactly which instruments were allowed to play during that run-through.
findings.japanese:
そして今日、やっとメンバーが揃ったということで、
待望の初合わせ…
findings.todokanai: And today, when my long awaited meeting with the orchestra finally arrived…

findings.highlight: There's nothing concrete about what is happening yet
findings.evidenceJa: 今すぐどうこうということはないという説明
findings.explanation: The doctor says no immediate crisis is expected, although Youko is certainly weakening and eating little. Todokanai TL changes temporal reassurance into uncertainty about what is happening at all.
findings.japanese:
別に、今すぐどうこうということはないという説明だけど、
それでも衰弱しているのは確かで、
食事もあまり摂れていないらしい。
findings.todokanai: There's nothing concrete about what is happening yet, but we do know that her condition is deteriorating, and that she's not been eating well.

findings.highlight: The performance that disgusting conductor called a "faux-concert."
findings.evidenceJa: 日本での、最後のコンサート
findings.explanation: Kazusa recalls her final concert in Japan. Todokanai TL omits 'last,' weakening the connection between that farewell performance and the later separations replayed in her dream.
findings.japanese:
あのクソ指揮者に『お遊戯会』と称された、
日本での、最後のコンサート。
findings.todokanai: The performance that disgusting conductor called a "faux-concert."

findings.highlight: the requiem Mom is waiting for
findings.evidenceJa: 母さんにとっては、引導になってしまう可能性
findings.explanation: Kazusa fears performing Cloture may become the decisive final send-off that allows Youko to die without regrets. Todokanai TL calls the concerto itself a requiem, assigning it a musical genre and saying Youko is waiting for death rather than questioning the performance's effect.
findings.japanese:
あたしがｃｌｏｔｕｒｅを弾くことって、
母さんにとっては、
引導になってしまう可能性、本当にないのかな…？
findings.todokanai: Can I say for certain that Cloture isn't the requiem Mom is waiting for?

findings.highlight: how much I excelled in playing the piano, almost like a recruiter.
findings.evidenceJa: 自分がどれだけ秀でたパフォーマンスを披露できるか…それ以外にはあまり興味のない、探求者のような冬馬曜子
findings.explanation: The younger Youko cared chiefly about how outstanding a performance she herself could present, living like a seeker or explorer. Todokanai TL makes Kazusa's ability the object of Youko's interest and turns 探求者 into a recruiter, reversing the subject and inventing the role.
findings.japanese:
自分がどれだけ秀でたパフォーマンスを披露できるか…
それ以外にはあまり興味のない、探求者のような冬馬曜子。
findings.todokanai: Someone who was completely uninterested in anything other than how much I excelled in playing the piano, almost like a recruiter.

findings.highlight: I went to school for no other reason than the unreliable intel that he might be there.
findings.evidenceJa: 炎天下、死ぬ思いをして学校まで来て、話しかけるタイミングを、必死で探って
findings.explanation: Kazusa came to school through deadly heat and desperately searched for a chance to speak to Haruki. Todokanai TL omits both actions after the uncertain information, weakening the evidence from which she recognizes she was already in love.
findings.japanese:
ただ、あいつがいるかもって不確かな情報だけを頼りに、
炎天下、死ぬ思いをして学校まで来て、
話しかけるタイミングを、必死で探って…
findings.todokanai: Despite the scorching heat, I went to school for no other reason than the unreliable intel that he might be there.

findings.highlight: someone had to lose, and I knew the winner couldn't get away without their share of pain either.
findings.evidenceJa: 誰かが引かないといけないって。けれど、誰かが引いても痛みはおさまらないって
findings.explanation: Kazusa knew somebody had to withdraw, yet even somebody withdrawing would not make the pain subside. Todokanai TL invents a winner/loser structure and relocates the continuing pain specifically onto the winner.
findings.japanese:
誰かが引かないといけないって。
けれど、誰かが引いても痛みはおさまらないって。
findings.todokanai: I knew someone had to lose, and I knew the winner couldn't get away without their share of pain either.

findings.highlight: Always keeping me at arm's length, but never letting me reach you.
findings.evidenceJa: 手が届かないくせに、ずっと近くにいろなんて、そんな拷問を思いついたのもお前だろ
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki was out of her reach yet told her to remain close forever, thereby inventing that torture. Todokanai TL instead makes him actively hold her at arm's length and prevent her from reaching him, altering the mechanism and agency of the complaint.
findings.japanese:
「手が届かないくせに、ずっと近くにいろなんて、
そんな拷問を思いついたのもお前だろ！」
findings.todokanai: "Always keeping me at arm's length, but never letting me reach you. Wasn't that torture your idea!?"

findings.highlight: I backed away, but then I forced myself upon him.
findings.explanation: Kazusa describes pulling back and then pushing, the contradictory actions by which she broke the trio. 'Forced myself upon him' adds a sexual or coercive action not stated by the compact push-pull image.
findings.japanese:
引いて、押した。
三人を、壊した。
かけがえのない仲間を、めちゃめちゃにした。
findings.todokanai: I backed away, but then I forced myself upon him. I broke the three of us. I made a mess of our irreplaceable friendship.

findings.highlight: the person who was my friend
findings.explanation: Kazusa says she hurt her best friend. Todokanai TL demotes Setsuna to somebody who merely was her friend, weakening both intimacy and the guilt central to the confession.
findings.japanese:
好きなひとを傷つけて、
親友を傷つけて、
ただひとり、逃げ出して…
findings.todokanai: I hurt the person I loved. I hurt the person who was my friend. Then I ran away by myself…

findings.highlight: Everything will be solved if you just pull your hand away.
findings.evidenceJa: お前が手を引けば、すぐに解ける
findings.explanation: Haruki is not gripping her: if Kazusa withdraws her own hand, their interlaced contact will immediately come apart. Todokanai TL says everything will be solved, inflating a precise physical fact into a promise that their emotional crisis has a solution.
findings.japanese:
「お前が手を引けば、すぐに解ける。
お前は、どこへでも行ける」
findings.todokanai: "Everything will be solved if you just pull your hand away. You'll be able to go anywhere."

findings.highlight: I had even erased him from the phone's memory.
findings.evidenceJa: 記憶からだって、消した、はずだ
findings.explanation: After confirming the number is absent from her contacts, Kazusa says she was supposed to have erased it even from her own memory. Todokanai TL redundantly returns to the phone's memory and deletes the claim about trying to forget him herself.
findings.japanese:
携帯のアドレスを確かめる。
もちろん、そこにはもう、あいつの番号なんかない。
記憶からだって、消した、はずだ。
findings.todokanai: I look at my phone contacts, and his number is of course no longer there. I had even erased him from the phone's memory.
